# El Palacio del Café

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Coffee brand and online store in Uruguay built on the Fenicio platform. Sells coffee in beans, ground, soluble and capsules, coffee makers and brewing accessories. States an interior delivery option in 72 business hours; full interior coverage is not stated on the homepage.
